data.title: 椎叶紬 · 下一次出门
data.description: 桌上并排放着两张车票，紬正认真研究目的地的地图。她抬起头问你要不要绕去那家小店，笔尖已经替你留好了选择的空格。
data.action: looking up from a map and two train tickets
data.promptProse: At a dining table, Tsumugi looks up from a map and two train tickets to ask her partner about a stop along their trip.
data.animaCaption: Two tickets lie together on the map while she looks toward her partner.
